completion_data.completion_summary: Added a single shared skill_gate_completion_claim function to skill-base.sh implementing the three-case fail-closed completion-claim gate, wired it into all three orchestrator call sites (base Stage 5, base Stage MT-4, hard Stage 5) replacing the drifted inline gates, and reconciled handoff-schema.md and orchestrate-state-machine.md to document top-level phases_completed/phases_total and the new fail-closed plan_markers_verified contract. All edits confined to agent-system/extensions/core/**; a Load Core deploy is required before this takes effect under .claude/.

memory_candidates.content: When unifying drifted inline logic across multiple call sites in bash-in-markdown SKILL.md files, add the shared function to skill-base.sh as purely additive (never touching existing functions), then verify additive-only-ness with `git diff -U0 <file> | grep -c '^-[^-]'` expecting 0 deletions before wiring any call site. This makes a partial rollout (some call sites wired, some not) always safe, since the un-wired sites keep their existing behavior unchanged.

For a fail-closed evidence gate with 3+ cases and multiple call sites, a bash unit harness sourcing the function directly (export SKILL_REPO_ROOT then `source skill-base.sh`) and asserting both the return code AND a greppable log-line token per case gives fast, precise regression coverage without needing to exercise the full orchestrator state machine.
